review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C scenario. The complete PRD fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input while explicitly preserving humanConfirmed=false; an empty human-decision input is therefore consistent with ready readiness and no blocking reasons. This does not resolve DEC-001 in paired B, where a material unresolved decision must block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and both task keys remain stable. The exact writable binding scope contains the implementation/type owner and regression test owner; supplied build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated, not separately maintained owners. Existing zero/omission behavior can remain unchanged, while invalid-number construction-time rejection needs implementation and regression coverage. The PRD requires implementation and independent verification coverage of every required AC, with TASK-VERIFY depending on TASK-IMPLEMENT. Frozen membership, availability and original project-scoped active capability claims support the two allowed assignees without inference from personas or pending claims. This invocation-local validation does not require shared-data or state capabilities. The selected planning reviewer is distinct from the implementer under the supplied reviewer-selection policy. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and supplied provenance explains the distinct original/saved PRD, manifest/evaluation-source and source/executing-bundle digest domains. Model, sampling, budgets and metric-policy fingerprints are consistently frozen. Preparation-time remaining/runnable fields are distinct from expected planning readiness. Review used only the supplied inputs, without candidate outputs, execution, independent digest recomputation or new human attestation.
